qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial ganglia
name: Eye, inner ear and cranial ganglion morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern embryonic morphogenesis of cranial sense organs and their nerves/ganglia; the eye (retina, iris, optic cup) and inner-ear components distinguish it from olfactory/facial confusables and from the lens/hair-cell-function confusable.

qualifier: coupled to Pol II transcription termination
name: Histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and transcription termination
rationale: Members cover stem-loop/SLBP-dependent and -independent histone mRNA 3'-end cleavage, its turnover and Pol II termination, unlike confusables about mRNA export, capping or splicing.

name: Rap1-mediated integrin activation and adhesion signalling
rationale: Members concern inside-out integrin activation, integrin-mediated cell-cell/matrix adhesion and Rap1/p130Cas/GRB2 signalling, which leukocyte-extravasation and shear-stress confusables lack.

qualifier: Pol I initiation and nucleolar chromatin control
name: rRNA gene transcription initiation and nucleolar chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover RNA Pol I promoter opening, PIC assembly and escape plus epigenetic rDNA control (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1), whereas confusables emphasize Pol I/III elongation and termination or MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis.

name: Mitochondrial DNA maintenance and mRNA turnover
rationale: Members concern mtDNA replication and repair and the stability/decay of mitochondrial RNAs, while confusables cover mitochondrial transcription, translation and RNA modification.

qualifier: NIK-dependent, with inherited IKK complex defects
name: Non-canonical NF-kB signalling and inherited IKK complex defects
rationale: Members centre on NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kB activation (TNFSF, Dectin-1) and IKBKB/IKBKG/IkBA deficiencies, distinct from TLR/TAK1, TNFR1 and NOD confusables driving canonical NF-kB.

qualifier: dendritic cell differentiation and resting DC signatures
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and T cell costimulation
rationale: Members concern DC differentiation/activation signatures and APC-driven T cell costimulation, unlike confusables about NK/tolerance or regulatory T cell differentiation.

name: Ferroptosis regulation and NADPH-linked redox homeostasis
rationale: Members span ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate metabolism and positive/negative ferroptosis control, which confusables on NRF2 targets, vitamin C or pentose phosphate lack.

name: Cilium assembly, centrosome and microtubule cytoskeleton organization
rationale: Members concern ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, axonemes, centrosome/centriole and microtubule organization including sperm flagella and photoreceptor cilia, unlike confusables about mitotic division machinery or Hedgehog/planar polarity.

name: GPCR-driven phospholipase C, IP3 and PKC signalling
rationale: Members concern GPCR/G-beta-gamma activation of PLC-beta and PI3K-gamma, IP3/calcium and protein kinase C signalling, which cAMP, BCR and Wnt-calcium confusables lack.

qualifier: linkage region and its genetic disorders
name: Chondroitin sulfate and linkage-region biosynthesis disorders
rationale: Members cover GAG–protein linkage tetrasaccharide and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate chain synthesis and their enzyme defects, distinct from heparan, keratan and dystroglycan glycosylation confusables.

core: Macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
rationale: Members concern M-CSF signalling, macrophage proliferation and microglial proliferation, migration and cytotoxic activation, while confusables cover microglial differentiation/inhibition or DAP12/interleukin signalling.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation, basement membrane and skeletal muscle development
rationale: Members link DAG1 O-mannosyl/matriglycan synthesis and its dystroglycanopathy defects to laminin/basement membrane assembly, the dystrophin complex and muscle/NMJ development, unlike GAG, contractile-sarcomere or collagen confusables.

qualifier: osteoclast-driven, with IGF and phosphate responses
name: Osteoclast bone remodelling, mineralization and IGF/phosphate responses
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation/fusion, bone resorption and mineralization with IGF and FGF23–Klotho phosphate responses, whereas confusables emphasize osteoblast/Wnt or tooth mineralization.

name: Na+/K+-ATPase sodium and potassium gradient maintenance
rationale: Members concern P-type ATPase-driven Na+/K+ homeostasis, its regulation and glycoside response, unlike potassium-channel, renal or magnesium transport confusables.

name: Type II and III interferon signalling and interferon-alpha response
rationale: Members cover IFN-gamma and IFN-lambda signalling and regulation plus interferon-alpha response modules, distinguishing them from IL-10/IL-12 family and other cytokine confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate synthesis (including CHST6 deficiency), distinct from confusables on other GAGs or mucopolysaccharidosis degradation.

name: Urea cycle citrulline–arginine synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: Members concern urea-cycle ornithine/citrulline/arginine synthesis, its transcriptional repression and ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency, while confusables cover other urea-cycle enzyme defects, arginine catabolism or transport.

name: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and xenobiotic metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis/recycling, bilirubin conjugation and SLCO/ABC-mediated drug and organic-anion transport with their disorders, unlike intestinal lipid absorption or organic cation confusables.

qualifier: cysteine palmitoylation cycle and RAS processing
name: Protein S-palmitoylation, depalmitoylation and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members concern reversible cysteine palmitoylation and C-terminal lipid processing of RAS, distinct from RAB geranylgeranylation and Hh/Wnt ligand acylation confusables.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated interleukin-1 processing
rationale: Members concern NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, purinergic activation and IL-1 precursor processing, whereas confusables cover AIM2/CASP4/5 pyroptosis and IL-18/IL-17 signalling.

name: Notch and canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover Notch receptor processing/NICD transcription, related intramembrane proteolysis, and beta-catenin destruction-complex signalling with cancer mutants, whereas confusables cover Hedgehog, DVL degradation or non-canonical Wnt.

qualifier: two-pore, ATP-sensitive and Ca2+-activated K+ channels
name: Potassium leak and K-ATP channels setting resting potential
rationale: Members concern K2P, K-ATP and Ca2+-activated potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization, unlike Na+/K+-ATPase, action-potential or sensory confusables.

name: Extracellular ATP/adenosine purinergic signalling and K-ATP channels in ischemia
rationale: Members cover ATP export, NTPDase hydrolysis, P2Y/P1 receptor signalling plus K-ATP channels and ischemia/hypoxia responses, which histamine/prostanoid, calcium or PLC confusables lack.

name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB receptors
rationale: Members concern ERBB/EGFR attenuation via ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB-lysosomal sorting with linked PTEN regulation, unlike MET/PTK6 signalling or generic ESCRT confusables.
